description: This is the implementation of the 'grep' command for git, including pattern compilation, matching logic, color output, and file/source handling.

methods.name: int grep_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Loads grep configuration options from git config variables and sets the corresponding fields in grep_opt.

methods.name: void grep_init(struct grep_opt * opt,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Initializes a grep_opt structure to default values and sets the repository context.

methods.name: struct:grep_pat * create_grep_pat(const char * pat,size_t patlen,const char * origin,int no,enum grep_pat_token t,enum grep_header_field field)
methods.description: Creates a new grep_pat structure with specified pattern and attributes.

methods.name: void do_append_grep_pat(struct grep_pat *** tail,struct grep_pat * p)

methods.name: void append_header_grep_pattern(struct grep_opt * opt,enum grep_header_field field,const char * pat)
methods.description: Adds a header pattern to the grep options.

methods.name: void append_grep_pattern(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * pat,const char * origin,int no,enum grep_pat_token t)
methods.description: Adds a general pattern to the grep options.

methods.name: void append_grep_pat(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * pat,size_t patlen,const char * origin,int no,enum grep_pat_token t)
methods.description: Creates and appends a pattern to the pattern list.

methods.name: struct:grep_opt * grep_opt_dup(const struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Duplicates an existing grep_opt structure.

methods.name: NORETURN void compile_regexp_failed(const struct grep_pat * p,const char * error)
methods.description: Handles failures during regexp compilation by printing error details and terminating.

methods.name: int is_fixed(const char * s,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if a pattern contains only literal characters (no special regex characters).

methods.name: void compile_pcre2_pattern(struct grep_pat * p UNUSED,const struct grep_opt * opt UNUSED)

methods.name: int pcre2match(struct grep_pat * p UNUSED,const char * line UNUSED,const char * eol UNUSED,regmatch_t * match UNUSED,int eflags UNUSED)

methods.name: void free_pcre2_pattern(struct grep_pat * p UNUSED)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a PCRE2 pattern.

methods.name: void compile_fixed_regexp(struct grep_pat * p,struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Compiles a literal string pattern into a regex (non-regex) form.

methods.name: void compile_regexp(struct grep_pat * p,struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Compiles a pattern into a regex object according to pattern type, handling fixed, PCRE, or traditional regexes.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_not_expr(struct grep_expr * expr)
methods.description: Creates a negation (NOT) expression node for pattern matching.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_binexp(enum grep_expr_node kind,struct grep_expr * left,struct grep_expr * right)
methods.description: Creates binary expression nodes (AND/OR) for pattern logical composition.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_or_expr(struct grep_expr * left,struct grep_expr * right)
methods.description: Creates an OR expression node.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_and_expr(struct grep_expr * left,struct grep_expr * right)
methods.description: Creates an AND expression node.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * compile_pattern_or(struct grep_pat ** list)
methods.description: Compiles a list of patterns into a logical pattern expression representing alternation.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * compile_pattern_atom(struct grep_pat ** list)
methods.description: Compiles a single pattern atom, handling parentheses for grouping.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * compile_pattern_not(struct grep_pat ** list)
methods.description: Processes NOT patterns in the pattern list.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * compile_pattern_and(struct grep_pat ** list)
methods.description: Handles AND patterns in the pattern list.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * compile_pattern_expr(struct grep_pat ** list)
methods.description: Starts the compilation of pattern expressions from pattern list.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_true_expr(void)
methods.description: Creates a true (always match) expression node.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * prep_header_patterns(struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Prepares header patterns for pattern matching, assembling them into expression nodes.

methods.name: struct:grep_expr * grep_splice_or(struct grep_expr * x,struct grep_expr * y)
methods.description: Splices OR expressions into a chain for pattern combination.

methods.name: void compile_grep_patterns(struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Compiles all patterns and header patterns into a logical expression used for matching.

methods.name: void free_pattern_expr(struct grep_expr * x)
methods.description: Recursively frees the pattern expression tree.

methods.name: void free_grep_pat(struct grep_pat * pattern)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a grep pattern list.

methods.name: void free_grep_patterns(struct grep_opt * opt)
methods.description: Frees all pattern and expression resources in grep options.

methods.name: const char * end_of_line(const char * cp,unsigned long * left)
methods.description: Finds the end of a line given a pointer and remaining length.

methods.name: int word_char(char ch)

methods.description: Outputs data with optional color styling if colors are enabled.

methods.name: void output_sep(struct grep_opt * opt,char sign)
methods.description: Outputs a separator character with optional color.

methods.name: void show_name(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * name)
methods.description: Outputs the filename with color and optional newline.

methods.name: int patmatch(struct grep_pat * p,const char * line,const char * eol,regmatch_t * match,int eflags)
methods.description: Matches a pattern against a line or buffer, using PCRE2 or standard regex.

methods.name: void strip_timestamp(const char * bol,const char ** eol_p)
methods.description: Removes timestamp info from headers, useful for commit logs.

methods.name: int match_one_pattern(struct grep_pat * p,const char * bol,const char * eol,enum grep_context ctx,regmatch_t * pmatch,int eflags)
methods.description: Matches a single pattern against a line, respecting header fields and word boundary rules.

methods.description: Recursively evaluates a pattern expression tree against a line.

methods.name: int match_expr(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * bol,const char * eol,enum grep_context ctx,ssize_t * col,ssize_t * icol,int collect_hits)
methods.description: Evaluates the pattern expression against a line.

methods.name: int match_line(struct grep_opt * opt,const char * bol,const char * eol,ssize_t * col,ssize_t * icol,enum grep_context ctx,int collect_hits)

methods.description: Displays a matched line with highlights, headers, and optional context.
